external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Abercrombie & Kent is a standout in luxury travel, offering tailor-made journeys, small-group expeditions, and immersive expedition cruises to destinations across all seven continents. For those who want every detail handled with care, A&K delivers with signature style and precision. Their portfolio also includes the A&K Sanctuary Retreats, a curated collection of chic lodges and camps in the world’s most breathtaking settings.

Backroads is a leader in luxury active travel, offering exceptional biking, hiking, and multi-adventure trips in stunning destinations around the world. Perfect for travelers who want adventure by day and comfort by night, Backroads pairs expertly designed itineraries with stays at beautiful, hand-picked hotels. With multiple route options, trip styles for all ages, and fun, knowledgeable guides, they make it easy to explore the world in an energizing and immersive way.

Belmond is synonymous with timeless elegance, offering a collection of iconic hotels, trains, river cruises, and safari lodges across the world’s most enchanting destinations. Each property reflects a strong sense of place, with historic charm, refined service, and exceptional attention to detail. As a member of the Belmond Bellini Club, we’re able to offer our clients exclusive perks — like upgrades, daily breakfast, and unique local experiences—making every stay even more memorable.

Crystal is known for delivering an elevated cruise experience, combining spacious all-suite accommodations with personalized service and world-class dining. Their reimagined ships offer a sophisticated, residential-style atmosphere with generous inclusions — like fine wines, specialty restaurants, and butler service in every suite. With thoughtfully curated itineraries and enrichment programs, Crystal is ideal for travelers seeking comfort, culture, and elegance at sea.

Explora Journeys offers a modern, European-inspired take on luxury cruising, blending the intimacy of a private yacht with the comfort and style of a boutique hotel. Their spacious, all-oceanfront suites, elevated dining concepts, and inclusive amenities create a relaxed yet refined onboard experience. With a focus on discovery, wellness, and meaningful travel, Explora is a wonderful choice for clients seeking a more personal and immersive way to explore the world by sea.

Four Seasons is a global leader in luxury hospitality, offering exceptional hotels, resorts, and private retreats in some of the world’s most desirable destinations. Known for their personalized service, refined design, and attention to detail, each property delivers a consistent level of comfort and elegance. Whether it’s a city escape, beachfront getaway, or alpine adventure, Four Seasons is a trusted favorite for travelers who value thoughtful luxury and a true sense of place.

Hyatt offers a diverse portfolio of luxury properties around the world, from sleek city hotels to serene beachfront resorts. With brands like Park Hyatt, Andaz, Alila, and Thompson, there’s a Hyatt stay to match every travel style — all delivering thoughtful service and elevated design. As a Hyatt Privé partner, we’re able to offer our clients exclusive benefits like room upgrades, daily breakfast, and personalized amenities to enhance your stay.

Lindblad Expeditions is a pioneer in expedition cruising, offering immersive, small-ship journeys to some of the world’s most remote and awe-inspiring places — from the Galápagos and Antarctica to Alaska and the Arctic. In partnership with National Geographic, their voyages feature expert guides, naturalists, and photographers who bring each destination to life. With a focus on discovery, education, and sustainability, Lindblad is ideal for curious travelers seeking meaningful, off-the-beaten-pa

Micato Safaris sets the standard for luxury safaris in Africa and now offers beautifully curated journeys through India. Their all-inclusive itineraries feature top-tier guides, seamless service, and stays at some of the region’s most luxurious lodges and hotels. Family-owned and award-winning, Micato blends culture, wildlife, and comfort into every experience. Our strong relationship with the Micato team ensures our clients enjoy added value and VIP touches throughout their journey.

Oceania is known for its casually elegant ships, destination-rich itineraries, and an exceptional culinary program that sets it apart in the world of premium cruising. With a relaxed, country-club atmosphere and port-intensive voyages, Oceania appeals to travelers who value fine dining, immersive exploration, and personalized service. It's a fantastic option for those seeking refined comfort, curated experiences, and outstanding value on the open sea.

Regent Seven Seas offers an ultra-luxury, all-inclusive cruise experience that combines elegance, comfort, and enriching exploration. With spacious suites, gourmet dining, and included shore excursions in every port, Regent delivers exceptional value and ease. We book Regent frequently and have dedicated advisors who specialize in their offerings — ensuring our clients receive expert guidance, exclusive perks, and a truly seamless journey from start to finish.

The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection brings the brand’s signature style and service to the sea, offering a refined, yacht-style cruising experience for those who prefer a more intimate and relaxed approach to ocean travel. With spacious suites, elevated dining, and personalized service, each voyage feels like a private escape. Designed for travelers who value luxury, comfort, and cultural immersion, these journeys offer a fresh way to explore the world’s most beautiful coastlines.

Seabourn offers an ultra-luxury cruise experience that feels both elegant and intimate, with all-suite accommodations, world-class dining, and warm service. Their small ships allow access to off-the-beaten-path ports, while curated excursions and enrichment programs provide meaningful cultural connections. With a relaxed, yacht-like atmosphere, Seabourn is a favorite among our clients seeking sophisticated travel by sea with every detail thoughtfully handled.

SeaDream offers a uniquely intimate yachting experience, with just 56 staterooms and a crew-to-guest ratio that ensures personalized, attentive service. These casually elegant voyages feel like sailing on your own private yacht — complete with gourmet dining, open bars, and a relaxed, all-inclusive atmosphere. With flexible itineraries focused on hidden harbors and less-traveled coastlines, SeaDream is perfect for clients seeking a luxurious and unhurried escape at sea.

Silversea is known for its ultra-luxury, all-suite cruises that blend elegance, comfort, and immersive exploration. With a nearly 1:1 staff-to-guest ratio, butler service in every suite, and gourmet dining across all ships, Silversea delivers a seamless, all-inclusive experience. Their itineraries range from classic Mediterranean and Caribbean sailings to remote expedition voyages in Antarctica and the Galápagos—making them a top choice for clients who want to explore the world in style and ease

Six Senses is a collection of luxury resorts known for their breathtaking natural settings, holistic wellness programs, and deep commitment to sustainability. Each property blends local character with elevated design, offering experiences that nourish both body and mind — from farm-to-table dining and spa rituals to immersive cultural activities. It’s an ideal choice for clients seeking meaningful, rejuvenating escapes in some of the world’s most beautiful and remote destinations.

Tauck is one of our most trusted guided travel partners, offering luxury land journeys, river cruises, and small-ship ocean cruises designed for discerning travelers of all ages. Known for their meticulous attention to detail and exceptional service, Tauck delivers immersive, all-inclusive experiences featuring premium accommodations, authentic cultural encounters, and seamless logistics. Viking is a leader in culturally enriching cruises, offering thoughtfully curated itineraries on both rivers and oceans. With sleek, Scandinavian-inspired ships, adults-only sailings, and a focus on destination immersion, Viking appeals to travelers who value comfort, learning, and seamless travel. We book Viking regularly and know their product inside and out — giving our clients the benefit of expert insight and access to exclusive perks.
